verdict.rationale: Salesforce exposes general-purpose APIs (salesforce-docs-7) and has an official MCP server (salesforce-probe-3) plus CLI tooling (salesforce-gh-1..8) that could theoretically support lead creation/enrichment, and Sales Cloud has lead management and lead scoring features (salesforce-docs-22, salesforce-docs-17). However, there is no evidence of an end-to-end documented workflow where an agent creates a lead, fills company data, and assigns an owner via API or MCP — no lead-specific API docs, MCP tool list, or hands-on example. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tool for lead CRUD, evidence of company-data enrichment step, evidence of owner-assignment logic, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of this exact workflow.
